interface.name: count
interface.description: Number of channels to be converted

interface.name: analogValues
interface.description: Variable-length analog array passed by reference to preserve its bounds. Read-only to the function block; no element may be modified.

interface.name: channels
interface.description: Channel records passed by reference. Configuration fields are read-only; write only retVal and outputValue.

initial_conditions.state: No internal history required. IN_OUT output fields retain caller-provided values when skipped.

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Process only the first count ordinal entries, pairing arrays at their independent lower bounds.
Do not modify raw analog values or any channel configuration.
assumptions: Disabled and out-of-count channels retain both retVal and outputValue.
Successful enabled conversion sets retVal=0. Invalid channels preserve outputValue while returning the error code.
Invalid measuringMode has priority over invalid hiLIM/loLIM. Limit validation applies to enabled channels in every mode.
Scaling extrapolates outside nominal raw range; no saturation is specified.
Test metadata array_lower_bounds defines the physical array indices used by the caller. JSON arrays are ordered storage values, not IEC index literals. The caller satisfies count bounds.

formal_properties.explanation: Input arrays and configuration are never modified.
Disabled and unprocessed channels are unchanged.
Unsupported modes return the defined status without conversion.
Invalid limits return their status without conversion.
Successful enabled channels clear their status.
Linear scale uses the correct unipolar or bipolar range.

atomic_propositions.j: An ordinal position starting at zero.
atomic_propositions.raw(j): Sampled analogValues at its lower bound+j.
atomic_propositions.scaled(j): loLIM+(raw/27648)*(hiLIM-loLIM) for unipolar; loLIM+((raw+27648)/55296)*(hiLIM-loLIM) for bipolar.
atomic_propositions.preserved(j): The channel retVal/outputValue equal sampled values.
atomic_propositions.readonlyPreserved: analogValues and channel configuration equal all their sampled values.
atomic_propositions.channel output names: Post-scan fields of the channel at the indicated ordinal position.
atomic_propositions.sampledOutputValue(j): The caller-provided outputValue before this scan.
atomic_propositions.measuringMode(j): The sampled measuringMode configuration for ordinal j.
